{"parentUuid":"58115328-16e4-4726-b8b4-678c1b377d22","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_vuh56hprtsmbpcmmr2mm2me4","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp23/a/internal/orset/orset_test.go","content":"package orset\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\nfunc vals(s *State) []string { return s.Values() }\n\nfunc TestAddRemoveLookup(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := New()\n\tif s.Lookup(\"a\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"empty set contains a\")\n\t}\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 1, \"a\")\n\tif !s.Lookup(\"a\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"a missing after add\")\n\t}\n\tgot := s.Remove(\"a\")\n\tif len(got) != 1 || got[0] != (Tag{\"n1\", 1}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"remove returned %v, want [n1:1]\", got)\n\t}\n\tif s.Lookup(\"a\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"a present after remove\")\n\t}\n\t// Removing an absent element is a no-op.\n\tif r := s.Remove(\"a\"); len(r) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"second remove = %v, want empty\", r)\n\t}\n\tif r := s.Remove(\"ghost\"); len(r) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"remove ghost = %v, want empty\", r)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReAddAfterRemove(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := New()\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 1, \"a\")\n\ts.Remove(\"a\")\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 2, \"a\")\n\tif !s.Lookup(\"a\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"re-add must make a live again via a new tag\")\n\t}\n\tif len(vals(s)) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"values = %v, want [a]\", vals(s))\n\t}\n}\n\n// Classic observed-remove scenario: A and B concurrently add the same\n// element. A removes having observed only its own tag. After merging, B's\n// unobserved concurrent add must survive.\nfunc TestObservedRemoveKeepsConcurrentAdd(t *testing.T) {\n\ta := New()\n\tb := New()\n\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"x\") // A: x tag A:1\n\tb.Add(\"B\", 1, \"x\") // B: x tag B:1, concurrent with A's add\n\n\ta.Remove(\"x\") // A only knows A:1 → tombstones A:1 only\n\tif a.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"A should no longer see x\")\n\t}\n\n\tc := New().Merge(a).Merge(b)\n\tif !c.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"concurrent add B:1 was wrongly removed\")\n\t}\n\t// The merge of in the other direction must behave the same.\n\tc2 := New().Merge(b).Merge(a)\n\tif !c2.Lookup(\"x\") || !c.Equal(c2) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"merge order changed the result\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Once B:1 is also observed, a subsequent remove clears x everywhere.\n\tc.Remove(\"x\")\n\tif c.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"x must be gone after observing both tags\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// Three replicas with add/delete; enumerate every pairwise-merge ordering and\n// check convergence and independence of order.\nfunc TestThreeReplicaMergeOrderEnumeration(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Build three divergent local histories.\n\tmk := func() (*State, *State, *State) {\n\t\ta, b, c := New(), New(), New()\n\t\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"a\")\n\t\ta.Add(\"A\", 2, \"b\")\n\t\t// b sees a,b then deletes a; concurrently c adds a.\n\t\tb.Merge(a)\n\t\tb.Add(\"B\", 1, \"c\")\n\t\tc.Add(\"C\", 1, \"a\") // concurrent add of a\n\t\tb.Remove(\"a\")      // tombstones A:1 only (C:1 unseen)\n\t\tc.Add(\"C\", 2, \"d\")\n\t\treturn a, b, c\n\t}\n\n\t// Reference join: union everything at once.\n\tra, rb, rc := mk()\n\twant := New().Merge(ra).Merge(rb).Merge(rc)\n\twantVals := want.Values()\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(wantVals, []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"d\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"reference values = %v, want [a b c d]\", wantVals)\n\t}\n\n\t// Enumerate every interleaving sequence length 6: each step picks one of\n\t// the 3 ordered pairs (a→b style merges modeled as merge into a running\n\t// state). Simpler exhaustive check: every permutation of \"merge the three\n\t// states into an empty accumulator\".\n\tstates := []*State{nil, nil, nil}\n\t{\n\t\ta, b, c := mk()\n\t\tstates[0], states[1], states[2] = a, b, c\n\t}\n\tperm := [][]int{{0, 1, 2}, {0, 2, 1}, {1, 0, 2}, {1, 2, 0}, {2, 0, 1}, {2, 1, 0}}\n\tfor _, p := range perm {\n\t\tacc := New()\n\t\tfor _, i := range p {\n\t\t\tacc.Merge(states[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tif got := acc.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantVals) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"merge permutation %v values = %v, want %v\", p, got, wantVals)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !acc.Equal(want) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"merge permutation %v produced different state\", p)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Also enumerate pairwise-gossip merge orders: merge pair AB, then with C,\n\t// in all orders of the first pair and both directions.\n\tpairs := [][3]int{\n\t\t{0, 1, 2}, {1, 0, 2},\n\t\t{0, 2, 1}, {2, 0, 1},\n\t\t{1, 2, 0}, {2, 1, 0},\n\t}\n\tfor _, q := range pairs {\n\t\ta, b, c := mk()\n\t\tx, y, z := a, b, c\n\t\tall := []**State{&x, &y, &z}\n\t\ts1, s2, s3 := *all[q[0]], *all[q[1]], *all[q[2]]\n\t\ts1.Merge(s2)\n\t\ts2.Merge(s1) // bidirectional gossip\n\t\ts3.Merge(s1)\n\t\ts1.Merge(s3)\n\t\ts2.Merge(s3)\n\t\ts3.Merge(s2)\n\t\tif !s1.Equal(s2) || !s2.Equal(s3) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"pairwise order %v: replicas not equal after gossip\", q)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif got := s1.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantVals) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"pairwise order %v: values %v want %v\", q, got, wantVals)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Property-style check: Merge is commutative, associative and idempotent over\n// many randomly generated states.\nfunc TestMergeAlgebraRandomized(t *testing.T) {\n\trng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(7))\n\tnodes := []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\", \"D\"}\n\trandState := func() *State {\n\t\ts := New()\n\t\tseqs := map[string]uint64{}\n\t\tfor _, e := range []string{\"x\", \"y\", \"z\", \"w\"} {\n\t\t\tfor k := 0; k < rng.Intn(3); k++ {\n\t\t\t\tn := nodes[rng.Intn(len(nodes))]\n\t\t\t\tseqs[n]++\n\t\t\t\ttag := s.Add(n, seqs[n], e)\n\t\t\t\tif rng.Intn(2) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\t// Can only tombstone tags this state actually added here\n\t\t\t\t\t// (its own tags are by definition observed).\n\t\t\t\t\ts.Removed[tag] = struct{}{}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn s\n\t}\n\tfor iter := 0; iter < 200; iter++ {\n\t\ta, b, c := randState(), randState(), randState()\n\n\t\t// idempotent: a ⊔ a = a\n\t\tai := a.Clone().Merge(a)\n\t\tif !ai.Equal(a) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"iter %d: merge not idempotent\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// commutative: a ⊔ b = b ⊔ a\n\t\tab := a.Clone().Merge(b)\n\t\tba := b.Clone().Merge(a)\n\t\tif !ab.Equal(ba) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"iter %d: merge not commutative\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// associative: (a ⊔ b) ⊔ c = a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)\n\t\tl := a.Clone().Merge(b).Merge(c)\n\t\tr := a.Clone().Merge(b.Clone().Merge(c))\n\t\tif !l.Equal(r) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"iter %d: merge not associative\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Duplicate synchronisation must be a no-op after the first delivery.\nfunc TestRepeatedSyncIsIdempotent(t *testing.T) {\n\ta := New()\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"x\")\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 2, \"y\")\n\tb := New()\n\tbefore := b.Clone()\n\tfor i := 0; i < 5; i++ {\n\t\tb.Merge(a)\n\t}\n\tif !b.Equal(New().Merge(before).Merge(a)) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"repeated identical sync changed state\")\n\t}\n\tif got := b.Values(); len(got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"values = %v, want [x y]\", got)\n\t}\n\t// Tombstones propagate the same way.\n\ta.Remove(\"x\")\n\tfor i := 0; i < 3; i++ {\n\t\tb.Merge(a)\n\t}\n\tif b.Lookup(\"x\") || !b.Lookup(\"y\") {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"tombstone sync wrong: values %v\", b.Values())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestJSONRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := New()\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 1, \"a\")\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 2, \"a\")\n\ts.Add(\"n2\", 1, \"b\")\n\ts.Remove(\"a\") // tombstones n1:1, n1:2\n\n\traw, err := json.Marshal(s)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tvar got State\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &got); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif !got.Equal(s) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"round trip mismatch:\\n%s\\nwant %s\", got.Canonical(), s.Canonical())\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got.Values(), []string{\"b\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"values = %v, want [b]\", got.Values())\n\t}\n\t// Sorted, deterministic wire form for removed tags.\n\tvar anyJSON map[string]any\n\t_ = json.Unmarshal(raw, &anyJSON)\n\trem, _ := anyJSON[\"removed\"].([]any)\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rem, []any{\"n1:1\", \"n1:2\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"removed = %v, want sorted [n1:1 n1:2]\", rem)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Coordinated reclamation after all replicas observed tag+tombstone must\n// preserve query results; reclaiming with an uninformed witness must be\n// refused (stability precondition).\nfunc TestReclaimStability(t *testing.T) {\n\ta, b, c := New(), New(), New()\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"x\")\n\tb.Merge(a)\n\tc.Merge(a)\n\ta.Remove(\"x\")\n\t// b,c observe the tombstone.\n\tb.Merge(a)\n\tc.Merge(a)\n\n\tif a.Lookup(\"x\") || b.Lookup(\"x\") || c.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"x should be removed everywhere\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Unstable: c is not a witness for the tombstone → must not reclaim.\n\tpre := a.Clone()\n\tif n := a.Reclaim([]Tag{{\"A\", 1}}, b); n != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"reclaimed %d tags without all witnesses\", n)\n\t}\n\tif !a.Equal(pre) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"state changed after unsafe reclaim attempt\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Stable: all three know tag and tombstone → safe on all replicas.\n\ttags := StableTags(\"x\", a, b, c)\n\tif len(tags) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stable tags = %v, want [A:1]\", tags)\n\t}\n\tfor _, s := range []*State{a, b, c} {\n\t\tif n := s.Reclaim(tags, a, b, c); n != 1 {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"reclaim returned %d, want 1\", n)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif s.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(\"query changed after safe reclaim\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !a.Equal(b) || !b.Equal(c) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"replicas diverged after GC\")\n\t}\n\tif len(a.Tombstones()) != 0 || len(a.Adds) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"state not compacted: %s\", a.Canonical())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestValuesSorted(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := New()\n\tfor _, e := range []string{\"c\", \"a\", \"b\"} {\n\t\ts.Add(\"n\", uint64(e[0]), e)\n\t}\n\tif got := s.Values(); {"parentUuid":"7772004a-6aaa-4752-a013-30f3c290f7bf","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_9qr8jgxzamjd7l56engp8b58","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp23/a/internal/sim/sim_test.go","content":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\torsetsim \"orsetsim/internal/orset\"\n)\n\nfunc baseConfig() Config {\n\treturn Config{\n\t\tSeed:  42,\n\t\tNodes: []string{\"n1\", \"n2\", \"n3\"},\n\t\tNetwork: NetworkConfig{\n\t\t\tLossProb: 0, DuplicateProb: 0, ReorderProb: 0,\n\t\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 1,\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc runCfg(t *testing.T, cfg Config) *Report {\n\tt.Helper()\n\te, err := NewEngine(cfg)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"config invalid: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn e.Run()\n}\n\nfunc TestPerfectNetworkConverges(t *testing.T) {\n\tcfg := baseConfig()\n\tcfg.Events = []Op{\n\t\t{Time: 1, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"a\"},\n\t\t{Time: 2, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 4, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"remove\", Element: \"a\"},\n\t\t{Time: 5, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 7, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t}\n\tr := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\tif !r.Converged {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"did not converge: %v\", r.Nodes)\n\t}\n\tif len(r.FinalValues) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"final = %v, want empty set\", r.FinalValues)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Determinism: same config (same seed) → byte-identical report.\nfunc TestDeterministicReplay(t *testing.T) {\n\tcfg := noisyConfig()\n\tr1 := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\tr2 := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\tb1, _ := json.Marshal(r1)\n\tb2, _ := json.Marshal(r2)\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(b1, b2) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"same seed produced different reports\")\n\t}\n\t// Different seed should usually produce a different trace under loss, but\n\t// still converge once traffic flushes.\n\tcfg2 := cfg\n\tcfg2.Seed = 99\n\tr3 := runCfg(t, cfg2)\n\tb3, _ := json.Marshal(r3)\n\tif reflect.DeepEqual(b1, b3) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"different seeds unexpectedly produced identical traces\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc noisyConfig() Config {\n\tcfg := baseConfig()\n\tcfg.Network = NetworkConfig{\n\t\tLossProb: 0.3, DuplicateProb: 0.4, ReorderProb: 0.6,\n\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 3,\n\t}\n\tcfg.Events = []Op{\n\t\t{Time: 1, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"a\"},\n\t\t{Time: 2, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"b\"},\n\t\t{Time: 3, Node: \"n3\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"c\"},\n\t\t{Time: 4, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 5, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 6, Node: \"n3\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t// repeated gossip rounds so dropped messages get retransmitted\n\t\t{Time: 20, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 22, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 24, Node: \"n3\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 40, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 42, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 44, Node: \"n3\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t}\n\treturn cfg\n}\n\n// With drops, duplicates and reordering, enough gossip rounds must converge\n// all three replicas to the union. This is the \"重复同步收敛\" acceptance test.\nfunc TestLossyReorderedRepeatedSyncConverges(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, seed := range []int64{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 17, 42, 100, 2024} {\n\t\tcfg := noisyConfig()\n\t\tcfg.Seed = seed\n\t\tr := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\t\tif !r.Converged {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"seed %d: replicas did not converge after repeated sync:\\n%s\",\n\t\t\t\tseed, dumpNodes(r))\n\t\t}\n\t\twant := []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}\n\t\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(r.FinalValues, want) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"seed %d: final = %v, want %v\", seed, r.FinalValues, want)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.Counts[\"drop\"] == 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"seed %d: no drops occurred, test did not exercise loss\", seed)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.Counts[\"deliver\"] > r.Counts[\"send\"] {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"seed %d: deliveries (%d) > sends (%d) would require dup; check counts\",\n\t\t\t\tseed, r.Counts[\"deliver\"], r.Counts[\"send\"])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Explicit out-of-order delivery: a later full-state sync arrives before an\n// earlier one. CRDT merge must converge regardless. Enumerate both arrival\n// orders at the OR-Set level (the sim-level random version is tested above).\nfunc TestOutOfOrderMergeEnumeration(t *testing.T) {\n\tmkPair := func() (*orsetsim.State, *orsetsim.State) {\n\t\tsrc := orsetsim.New()\n\t\tsrc.Add(\"n1\", 1, \"a\") // snapshot v1: {a}\n\n\t\tv1 := src.Clone()\n\t\tsrc.Add(\"n1\", 2, \"b\")\n\t\tsrc.Remove(\"a\") // snapshot v2: {b}, tombstone A:1\n\t\tv2 := src.Clone()\n\t\treturn v1, v2\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, order := range [][]int{{0, 1}, {1, 0}} {\n\t\tdst := orsetsim.New()\n\t\tv1, v2 := mkPair()\n\t\tsnaps := []*orsetsim.State{v1, v2}\n\t\tdst.Merge(snaps[order[0]])\n\t\tdst.Merge(snaps[order[1]])\n\t\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(dst.Values(), []string{\"b\"}) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"delivery order %v: values = %v, want [b]\", order, dst.Values())\n\t\t}\n\t\tif dst.Lookup(\"a\") {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"delivery order %v: stale snapshot resurrected a\", order)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Concurrent adds against the same element with a remove in the middle must\n// keep the concurrent add (acceptance: 并发新增保留) at the simulator level.\nfunc TestSimConcurrentAddPreserved(t *testing.T) {\n\tcfg := baseConfig()\n\tcfg.Events = []Op{\n\t\t{Time: 1, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"x\"},\n\t\t// n1 and n2 both add x before either has heard from the other.\n\t\t{Time: 1, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"x\"},\n\t\t{Time: 3, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"remove\", Element: \"x\"}, // saw only its own tag\n\t\t{Time: 5, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 7, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 9, Node: \"n3\", Op: \"sync\", Target: \"n2\"},\n\t\t{Time: 11, Node: \"n3\", Op: \"sync\", Target: \"n1\"},\n\t}\n\tr := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\tif !r.Converged {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"did not converge: %s\", dumpNodes(r))\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(r.FinalValues, []string{\"x\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"concurrent add lost: final = %v, want [x]\", r.FinalValues)\n\t}\n}\n\n// 100% reordered network (no loss) converges immediately.\nfunc TestFullReorderConverges(t *testing.T) {\n\tcfg := baseConfig()\n\tcfg.Network.ReorderProb = 0.999\n\tcfg.Network.MaxDelay = 2\n\tcfg.Events = []Op{\n\t\t{Time: 1, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"a\"},\n\t\t{Time: 2, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 3, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"b\"},\n\t\t{Time: 4, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 30, Node: \"n3\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t}\n\tr := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\tif !r.Converged || !reflect.DeepEqual(r.FinalValues, []string{\"a\", \"b\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"reorder-only run failed: converged=%v vals=%v\\n%s\",\n\t\t\tr.Converged, r.FinalValues, dumpNodes(r))\n\t}\n\tif r.Counts[\"reorder\"] == 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"expected reordered messages\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// Duplicate-only network: idempotent merge leaves exactly one effect.\nfunc TestDuplicateDeliveryIdempotent(t *testing.T) {\n\tcfg := baseConfig()\n\tcfg.Network.DuplicateProb = 0.999\n\tcfg.Events = []Op{\n\t\t{Time: 1, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"a\"},\n\t\t{Time: 2, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 20, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t}\n\tr := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\tif !r.Converged {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"dup run did not converge: %s\", dumpNodes(r))\n\t}\n\t// Count tag occurrences in n2's state: must remain one per add despite\n\t// duplicated deliveries.\n\tfor _, nf := range r.Nodes {\n\t\tfor e, tags := range nf.State.Adds {\n\t\t\tseen := map[orsetsim.Tag]int{}\n\t\t\tfor _, tg := range tags {\n\t\t\t\tseen[tg]++\n\t\t\t\tif seen[tg] > 1 {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"node %s element %s has duplicated tag %v\", nf.Node, e, tg)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Complete loss of the only sync means known divergence and converged=false.\nfunc TestTotalLossDoesNotFalselyConverge(t *testing.T) {\n\tcfg := baseConfig()\n\tcfg.Network.LossProb = 0.999\n\tcfg.Events = []Op{\n\t\t{Time: 1, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"a\"},\n\t\t{Time: 2, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t}\n\tr := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\tif r.Converged {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"report must say converged=false when every message was lost\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// Coordinated GC after all replicas observed the tombstone compacts state\n// without changing queries.\nfunc TestSimCoordinatedGC(t *testing.T) {\n\tcfg := baseConfig()\n\tcfg.Events = []Op{\n\t\t{Time: 1, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"x\"},\n\t\t{Time: 2, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 5, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"remove\", Element: \"x\"},\n\t\t{Time: 6, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 8, Node: \"n2\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 10, Node: \"n3\", Op: \"sync\"},\n\t\t{Time: 12, Node: \"n1\", Op: \"gc\"},\n\t}\n\tr := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\tif !r.Converged || len(r.FinalValues) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"gc precondition failed: converged=%v vals=%v\", r.Converged, r.FinalValues)\n\t}\n\tfor _, nf := range r.Nodes {\n\t\tif len(nf.State.Adds) != 0 || len(nf.State.Tombstones()) != 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"node %s not compacted after GC: %s\", nf.Node, nf.State.Canonical())\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Random fuzz: random ops + noisy network + many gossip rounds must always\n// converge to the same join on every seed.\nfunc TestFuzzConvergence(t *testing.T) {\n\trng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(12345))\n\tfor iter := 0; iter < 25; iter++ {\n\t\tcfg := baseConfig()\n\t\tcfg.Seed = int64(iter + 1)\n\t\tcfg.Network = NetworkConfig{\n\t\t\tLossProb: 0.4, DuplicateProb: 0.3, ReorderProb: 0.5,\n\t\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 3,\n\t\t}\n\t\telems := []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}\n\t\tvar evs []Op\n\t\ttick := uint64(1)\n\t\t// Compute expected result deterministically with a shadow CRDT per node\n\t\t// merged on every gossip regardless of loss.\n\t\tshadow := map[string]*orsetsim.State{}\n\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\tshadow[n] = orsetsim.New()\n\t\t}\n\t\tapplyShadow := func(node, op, elem string) {\n\t\t\tif op == \"add\" {\n\t\t\t\tseq := uint64(0)\n\t\t\t\tfor _, t := range shadow[node].Adds[elem] {\n\t\t\t\t\t_ = t\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t// mirror engine's counter loosely: tags only need uniqueness\n\t\t\t\tshadow[node].Add(node, rng.Uint64(), elem)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tshadow[node].Remove(elem)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor round := 0; round < 8; round++ {\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\t\te := elems[rng.Intn(len(elems))]\n\t\t\t\tif rng.Intn(2) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tevs = append(evs, Op{Time: tick, Node: n, Op: \"add\", Element: e})\n\t\t\t\t\tapplyShadow(n, \"add\", e)\n\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\tevs = append(evs, Op{Time: tick, Node: n, Op: \"remove\", Element: e})\n\t\t\t\t\tapplyShadow(n, \"remove\", e)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\ttick++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// gossip round; shadow merges all into all (the eventual join)\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\t\tevs = append(evs, Op{Time: tick, Node: n, Op: \"sync\"})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ttick++\n\t\t\tjoin := orsetsim.New()\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\t\tjoin.Merge(shadow[n])\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\t\tshadow[n] = join.Clone()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ttick += 25 // let delayed messages drain\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.Events = evs\n\t\tr := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\t\tif !r.Converged {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"fuzz iter %d: no convergence\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Because removes in the shadow happen after the same adds the engine\n\t\t// does (tag counter differs but values semantics match), compare sets:\n\t\t// the engine converges to the join of its own states; verify all\n\t\t// values are from the allowed alphabet.\n\t\tfor _, v := range r.FinalValues {\n\t\t\tif v != \"a\" && v != \"b\" && v != \"c\" {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"fuzz iter %d: unexpected value %q\", iter, v)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestValidationErrors(t *testing.T) {\n\tbad := []Config{\n\t\t{Nodes: nil},\n\t\t{Nodes: []string{\"a\", \"a\"}},\n\t\t{Nodes: []string{\"a\"}, Network: NetworkConfig{MinDelay: 5, MaxDelay: 1}},\n\t\t{Nodes: []string{\"a\"}, Network: NetworkConfig{LossProb: 1}},\n\t\t{Nodes: []string{\"a\"}, Events: []Op{{Node: \"b\", Op: \"add\", Element: \"x\"}}},\n\t\t{Nodes: []string{\"a\"}, Events: []Op{{Node: \"a\", Op: \"frobnicate\"}}},\n\t\t{Nodes: []string{\"a\", \"b\"}, Events: []Op{{Node: \"a\", Op: \"sync\", Target: \"a\"}}},\n\t\t{Nodes: []string{\"a\", \"b\"}, Events: []Op{{Node: \"a\", Op: \"sync\", Target: \"zzz\"}}},\n\t}\n\tfor i, cfg := range bad {\n\t\te, err := NewEngine(cfg)\n\t\tif err == nil {\n\t\t\t_ = e\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"bad config %d accepted\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc dumpNodes(r *Report) string {\n\ts := \"\"\n\tfor _, nf := range r.Nodes {\n\t\ts += fmt.Sprintf(\"  %s: %s\\n\", nf.Node, nf.State.Canonical())\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_87e3b226a128178d636789b6","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3679,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":49976,"output_tokens":4719,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_9qr8jgxzamjd7l56engp8b58":{"content":"package iter < 25; iter++ {\n\t\tcfg := baseConfig()\n\t\tcfg.Seed = int64(iter + 1)\n\t\tcfg.Network = NetworkConfig{\n\t\t\tLossProb: 0.4, DuplicateProb: 0.3, ReorderProb: 0.5,\n\t\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 3,\n\t\t}\n\t\telems := []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}\n\t\tvar evs []Op\n\t\ttick := uint64(1)\n\t\t// Compute expected result deterministically with a shadow CRDT per node\n\t\t// merged on every gossip regardless of loss.\n\t\tshadow := map[string]*orsetsim.State{}\n\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\tshadow[n] = orsetsim.New()\n\t\t}\n\t\tapplyShadow := func(node, op, elem string) {\n\t\t\tif op == \"add\" {\n\t\t\t\tseq := uint64(0)\n\t\t\t\tfor _, t := range shadow[node].Adds[elem] {\n\t\t\t\t\t_ = t\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t// mirror engine's counter loosely: tags only need uniqueness\n\t\t\t\tshadow[node].Add(node, rng.Uint64(), elem)\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\tshadow[node].Remove(elem)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor round := 0; round < 8; round++ {\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\t\te := elems[rng.Intn(len(elems))]\n\t\t\t\tif rng.Intn(2) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\tevs = append(evs, Op{Time: tick, Node: n, Op: \"add\", Element: e})\n\t\t\t\t\tapplyShadow(n, \"add\", e)\n\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\tevs = append(evs, Op{Time: tick, Node: n, Op: \"remove\", Element: e})\n\t\t\t\t\tapplyShadow(n, \"remove\", e)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\ttick++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// gossip round; shadow merges all into all (the eventual join)\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\t\tevs = append(evs, Op{Time: tick, Node: n, Op: \"sync\"})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ttick++\n\t\t\tjoin := orsetsim.New()\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\t\tjoin.Merge(shadow[n])\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\t\tshadow[n] = join.Clone()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ttick += 25 // let delayed messages drain\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.Events = evs\n\t\tr := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\t\tif !r.Converged {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"fuzz iter %d: no convergence\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Because removes in the shadow happen after the same adds the engine\n\t\t// does (tag counter differs but values semantics match), compare sets:\n\t\t// the engine converges to the join of its own states; verify all\n\t\t// values are from the allowed alphabet.\n\t\tfor _, v := range r.FinalValues {\n\t\t\tif v != \"a\" && v != \"b\" && v != \"c\" {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"fuzz iter %d: unexpected value %q\", iter, v)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}","new_string":"// Random fuzz: random ops + noisy network + repeated gossip rounds must\n// always converge (all replicas equal) on every seed.\nfunc TestFuzzConvergence(t *testing.T) {\n\trng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(12345))\n\tfor iter := 0; round < 8; round++ {\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\t\te := elems[rng.Intn(len(elems))]\n\t\t\t\top := \"add\"\n\t\t\t\tif rng.Intn(2) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\top = \"remove\"\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tevs = append(evs, Op{Time: tick, Node: n, Op: op, Element: e})\n\t\t\t\ttick++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range cfg.Nodes {\n\t\t\t\tevs = append(evs, Op{Time: tick, Node: n, Op: \"sync\"})\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ttick += 25 // let delayed/reordered messages drain before next round\n\t\t}\n\t\tcfg.Events = evs\n\t\tr := runCfg(t, cfg)\n\t\tif !r.AllStatesEqual {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"fuzz iter %d: replicas did not converge:\\n%s\", iter, dumpNodes(r))\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, v := range r.FinalValues {\n\t\t\tif v != \"a\" && v != \"b\" && v != \"c\" {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"fuzz iter %d: unexpected value %q\", iter, v)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_6ade221d4dd17ab32cdba349","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":748,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":58168,"output_tokens":1740,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_2eyn83m1i2q2qjy2r17aeh50":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp23/a/internal/sim/sim_test.go","new_string":"// Random fuzz: random ops + noisy network + repeated gossip rounds must\n// always converge (all replicas equal) on every seed.\nfunc TestFuzzConvergence(t *testing.T) {\n\trng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(12345))\n\tfor iter := 0; A removes having observed only its own tag. After merging, B's\n// unobserved concurrent add must survive.\nfunc TestObservedRemoveKeepsConcurrentAdd(t *testing.T) {\n\ta := New()\n\tb := New()\n\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"x\") // A: x tag A:1\n\tb.Add(\"B\", 1, \"x\") // B: x tag B:1, concurrent with A's add\n\n\ta.Remove(\"x\") // A only knows A:1 → tombstones A:1 only\n\tif a.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"A should no longer see x\")\n\t}\n\n\tc := New().Merge(a).Merge(b)\n\tif !c.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"concurrent add B:1 was wrongly removed\")\n\t}\n\t// The merge of in the other direction must behave the same.\n\tc2 := New().Merge(b).Merge(a)\n\tif !c2.Lookup(\"x\") || !c.Equal(c2) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"merge order changed the result\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Once B:1 is also observed, a subsequent remove clears x everywhere.\n\tc.Remove(\"x\")\n\tif c.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"x must be gone after observing both tags\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// Three replicas with add/delete; enumerate every pairwise-merge ordering and\n// check convergence and independence of order.\nfunc TestThreeReplicaMergeOrderEnumeration(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Build three divergent local histories.\n\tmk := func() (*State, *State, *State) {\n\t\ta, b, c := New(), New(), New()\n\t\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"a\")\n\t\ta.Add(\"A\", 2, \"b\")\n\t\t// b sees a,b then deletes a; concurrently c adds a.\n\t\tb.Merge(a)\n\t\tb.Add(\"B\", 1, \"c\")\n\t\tc.Add(\"C\", 1, \"a\") // concurrent add of a\n\t\tb.Remove(\"a\")      // tombstones A:1 only (C:1 unseen)\n\t\tc.Add(\"C\", 2, \"d\")\n\t\treturn a, b, c\n\t}\n\n\t// Reference join: union everything at once.\n\tra, rb, rc := mk()\n\twant := New().Merge(ra).Merge(rb).Merge(rc)\n\twantVals := want.Values()\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(wantVals, []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"d\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"reference values = %v, want [a b c d]\", wantVals)\n\t}\n\n\t// Enumerate every interleaving sequence length 6: each step picks one of\n\t// the 3 ordered pairs (a→b style merges modeled as merge into a running\n\t// state). Simpler exhaustive check: every permutation of \"merge the three\n\t// states into an empty accumulator\".\n\tstates := []*State{nil, nil, nil}\n\t{\n\t\ta, b, c := mk()\n\t\tstates[0], states[1], states[2] = a, b, c\n\t}\n\tperm := [][]int{{0, 1, 2}, {0, 2, 1}, {1, 0, 2}, {1, 2, 0}, {2, 0, 1}, {2, 1, 0}}\n\tfor _, p := range perm {\n\t\tacc := New()\n\t\tfor _, i := range p {\n\t\t\tacc.Merge(states[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tif got := acc.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantVals) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"pairwise order %v: values %v want %v\", q, got, wantVals)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Property-style check: Merge is commutative, associative and idempotent over\n// many randomly generated states.\nfunc TestMergeAlgebraRandomized(t *testing.T) {\n\trng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(7))\n\tnodes := []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\", \"D\"}\n\trandState := func() *State {\n\t\ts := New()\n\t\tseqs := map[string]uint64{}\n\t\tfor _, e := range []string{\"x\", \"y\", \"z\", \"w\"} {\n\t\t\tfor k := 0; iter < 200; iter++ {\n\t\ta, b, c := randState(), randState(), randState()\n\n\t\t// idempotent: a ⊔ a = a\n\t\tai := a.Clone().Merge(a)\n\t\tif !ai.Equal(a) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"iter %d: merge not idempotent\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// commutative: a ⊔ b = b ⊔ a\n\t\tab := a.Clone().Merge(b)\n\t\tba := b.Clone().Merge(a)\n\t\tif !ab.Equal(ba) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"iter %d: merge not commutative\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// associative: (a ⊔ b) ⊔ c = a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)\n\t\tl := a.Clone().Merge(b).Merge(c)\n\t\tr := a.Clone().Merge(b.Clone().Merge(c))\n\t\tif !l.Equal(r) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"iter %d: merge not associative\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Duplicate synchronisation must be a no-op after the first delivery.\nfunc TestRepeatedSyncIsIdempotent(t *testing.T) {\n\ta := New()\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"x\")\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 2, \"y\")\n\tb := New()\n\tbefore := b.Clone()\n\tfor i := 0; i < 5; i++ {\n\t\tb.Merge(a)\n\t}\n\tif !b.Equal(New().Merge(before).Merge(a)) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"repeated identical sync changed state\")\n\t}\n\tif got := b.Values(); len(got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"values = %v, want [x y]\", got)\n\t}\n\t// Tombstones propagate the same way.\n\ta.Remove(\"x\")\n\tfor i := 0; i < 3; i++ {\n\t\tb.Merge(a)\n\t}\n\tif b.Lookup(\"x\") || !b.Lookup(\"y\") {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"tombstone sync wrong: values %v\", b.Values())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestJSONRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := New()\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 1, \"a\")\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 2, \"a\")\n\ts.Add(\"n2\", 1, \"b\")\n\ts.Remove(\"a\") // tombstones n1:1, n1:2\n\n\traw, err := json.Marshal(s)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tvar got State\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &got); reclaiming with an uninformed witness must be\n// refused (stability precondition).\nfunc TestReclaimStability(t *testing.T) {\n\ta, b, c := New(), New(), New()\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"x\")\n\tb.Merge(a)\n\tc.Merge(a)\n\ta.Remove(\"x\")\n\t// b,c observe the tombstone.\n\tb.Merge(a)\n\tc.Merge(a)\n\n\tif a.Lookup(\"x\") || b.Lookup(\"x\") || c.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"x should be removed everywhere\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Unstable: c is not a witness for the tombstone → must not reclaim.\n\tpre := a.Clone()\n\tif n := a.Reclaim([]Tag{{\"A\", 1}}, b); {"parentUuid":"cded634e-3a53-4147-921b-9f3c0064eacc","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"两个剩余问题：\n\n1. **`Reclaim` 语义**：安全回收要求见证集 = 完整集群。调用方只传 `a,b`（`c` 是可能回归的失联副本）时，API 无法知道 `c` 的存在——所以安全设计应让调用方传入*完整成员列表*，由函数检查每个见证者。当前实现只检查传入者，无法捕获\"遗漏节点\"。改为要求显式传入全部节点状态，调用方必须自证完整；测试场景改为\"见证者 b 缺少墓碑\"来表达不稳定性，这更贴合实现能力。\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_d8f1545170cf74176392e490","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1092,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":63288,"output_tokens":578,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"0d2a8842-0683-46b5-b37f-e7f60f8ac543","timestamp":"2026-09-23T03:56:47.926Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"1075e89c-721a-4815-a8c4-855fcf29d7cd","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp23/a","sessionId":"1075e89c-721a-4815-a8c4-855fcf29d7cd","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp23-a","slug":"joyful-discovering-spark"}

Reclaim on A must be\n\t// refused even though A itself is fully tombstoned — reclaiming now and\n\t// later merging with B (which knows the tag but not the removal) would\n\t// resurrect x.\n\tpre := a.Clone()\n\tbStale := orsetsim.New() // a node that knows the tag but NOT the tombstone\n\tbStale.Add(\"A\", 1, \"x\")\n\tif n := a.Reclaim([]Tag{{\"A\", 1}}, a, bStale, c); n != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"reclaimed %d tags while a witness lacked the tombstone\", n)\n\t}\n\tif !a.Equal(pre) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"state changed after unsafe reclaim attempt\")\n\t}","originalFile":"package orset\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\nfunc vals(s *State) []string { return s.Values() }\n\nfunc TestAddRemoveLookup(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := New()\n\tif s.Lookup(\"a\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"empty set contains a\")\n\t}\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 1, \"a\")\n\tif !s.Lookup(\"a\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"a missing after add\")\n\t}\n\tgot := s.Remove(\"a\")\n\tif len(got) != 1 || got[0] != (Tag{\"n1\", 1}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"remove returned %v, want [n1:1]\", got)\n\t}\n\tif s.Lookup(\"a\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"a present after remove\")\n\t}\n\t// Removing an absent element is a no-op.\n\tif r := s.Remove(\"a\"); len(r) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"second remove = %v, want empty\", r)\n\t}\n\tif r := s.Remove(\"ghost\"); len(r) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"remove ghost = %v, want empty\", r)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReAddAfterRemove(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := New()\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 1, \"a\")\n\ts.Remove(\"a\")\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 2, \"a\")\n\tif !s.Lookup(\"a\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"re-add must make a live again via a new tag\")\n\t}\n\tif len(vals(s)) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"values = %v, want [a]\", vals(s))\n\t}\n}\n\n// Classic observed-remove scenario: A and B concurrently add the same\n// element. A removes having observed only its own tag. After merging, B's\n// unobserved concurrent add must survive.\nfunc TestObservedRemoveKeepsConcurrentAdd(t *testing.T) {\n\ta := New()\n\tb := New()\n\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"x\") // A: x tag A:1\n\tb.Add(\"B\", 1, \"x\") // B: x tag B:1, concurrent with A's add\n\n\ta.Remove(\"x\") // A only knows A:1 → tombstones A:1 only\n\tif a.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"A should no longer see x\")\n\t}\n\n\tc := New().Merge(a).Merge(b)\n\tif !c.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"concurrent add B:1 was wrongly removed\")\n\t}\n\t// The merge of in the other direction must behave the same.\n\tc2 := New().Merge(b).Merge(a)\n\tif !c2.Lookup(\"x\") || !c.Equal(c2) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"merge order changed the result\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Once B:1 is also observed, a subsequent remove clears x everywhere.\n\tc.Remove(\"x\")\n\tif c.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"x must be gone after observing both tags\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// Three replicas with add/delete; enumerate every pairwise-merge ordering and\n// check convergence and independence of order.\nfunc TestThreeReplicaMergeOrderEnumeration(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Build three divergent local histories.\n\tmk := func() (*State, *State, *State) {\n\t\ta, b, c := New(), New(), New()\n\t\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"a\")\n\t\ta.Add(\"A\", 2, \"b\")\n\t\t// b sees a,b then deletes a; concurrently c adds a.\n\t\tb.Merge(a)\n\t\tb.Add(\"B\", 1, \"c\")\n\t\tc.Add(\"C\", 1, \"a\") // concurrent add of a\n\t\tb.Remove(\"a\")      // tombstones A:1 only (C:1 unseen)\n\t\tc.Add(\"C\", 2, \"d\")\n\t\treturn a, b, c\n\t}\n\n\t// Reference join: union everything at once.\n\tra, rb, rc := mk()\n\twant := New().Merge(ra).Merge(rb).Merge(rc)\n\twantVals := want.Values()\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(wantVals, []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"d\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"reference values = %v, want [a b c d]\", wantVals)\n\t}\n\n\t// Enumerate every interleaving sequence length 6: each step picks one of\n\t// the 3 ordered pairs (a→b style merges modeled as merge into a running\n\t// state). !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantVals) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"merge permutation %v values = %v, want %v\", p, got, wantVals)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !acc.Equal(want) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"merge permutation %v produced different state\", p)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Also enumerate pairwise-gossip merge orders: merge pair AB, then with C,\n\t// in all orders of the first pair and both directions.\n\tpairs := [][3]int{\n\t\t{0, 1, 2}, {1, 0, 2},\n\t\t{0, 2, 1}, {2, 0, 1},\n\t\t{1, 2, 0}, {2, 1, 0},\n\t}\n\tfor _, q := range pairs {\n\t\ta, b, c := mk()\n\t\tx, y, z := a, b, c\n\t\tall := []**State{&x, &y, &z}\n\t\ts1, s2, s3 := *all[q[0]], *all[q[1]], *all[q[2]]\n\t\ts1.Merge(s2)\n\t\ts2.Merge(s1) // bidirectional gossip\n\t\ts3.Merge(s1)\n\t\ts1.Merge(s3)\n\t\ts2.Merge(s3)\n\t\ts3.Merge(s2)\n\t\tif !s1.Equal(s2) || !s2.Equal(s3) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"pairwise order %v: replicas not equal after gossip\", q)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif got := s1.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantVals) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"pairwise order %v: values %v want %v\", q, got, wantVals)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Property-style check: Merge is commutative, associative and idempotent over\n// many randomly generated states.\nfunc TestMergeAlgebraRandomized(t *testing.T) {\n\trng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(7))\n\tnodes := []string{\"A\", \"B\", \"C\", \"D\"}\n\trandState := func() *State {\n\t\ts := New()\n\t\tseqs := map[string]uint64{}\n\t\tfor _, e := range []string{\"x\", \"y\", \"z\", \"w\"} {\n\t\t\tfor k := 0; iter < 200; iter++ {\n\t\ta, b, c := randState(), randState(), randState()\n\n\t\t// idempotent: a ⊔ a = a\n\t\tai := a.Clone().Merge(a)\n\t\tif !ai.Equal(a) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"iter %d: merge not idempotent\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// commutative: a ⊔ b = b ⊔ a\n\t\tab := a.Clone().Merge(b)\n\t\tba := b.Clone().Merge(a)\n\t\tif !ab.Equal(ba) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"iter %d: merge not commutative\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// associative: (a ⊔ b) ⊔ c = a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)\n\t\tl := a.Clone().Merge(b).Merge(c)\n\t\tr := a.Clone().Merge(b.Clone().Merge(c))\n\t\tif !l.Equal(r) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"iter %d: merge not associative\", iter)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Duplicate synchronisation must be a no-op after the first delivery.\nfunc TestRepeatedSyncIsIdempotent(t *testing.T) {\n\ta := New()\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 1, \"x\")\n\ta.Add(\"A\", 2, \"y\")\n\tb := New()\n\tbefore := b.Clone()\n\tfor i := 0; i < 5; i++ {\n\t\tb.Merge(a)\n\t}\n\tif !b.Equal(New().Merge(before).Merge(a)) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"repeated identical sync changed state\")\n\t}\n\tif got := b.Values(); len(got) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"values = %v, want [x y]\", got)\n\t}\n\t// Tombstones propagate the same way.\n\ta.Remove(\"x\")\n\tfor i := 0; i < 3; i++ {\n\t\tb.Merge(a)\n\t}\n\tif b.Lookup(\"x\") || !b.Lookup(\"y\") {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"tombstone sync wrong: values %v\", b.Values())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestJSONRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := New()\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 1, \"a\")\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 2, \"a\")\n\ts.Add(\"n2\", 1, \"b\")\n\ts.Remove(\"a\") // tombstones n1:1, n1:2\n\n\traw, err := json.Marshal(s)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tvar got State\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &got); A removes having observed only its own tag. i < 3; i++ {\n\t\tb.Merge(a)\n\t}\n\tif b.Lookup(\"x\") || !b.Lookup(\"y\") {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"tombstone sync wrong: values %v\", b.Values())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestJSONRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := New()\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 1, \"a\")\n\ts.Add(\"n1\", 2, \"a\")\n\ts.Add(\"n2\", 1, \"b\")\n\ts.Remove(\"a\") // tombstones n1:1, n1:2\n\n\traw, err := json.Marshal(s)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tvar got State\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &got); Merge is set union on both the tag set and the tombstone set,\n// which makes it commutative, associative and idempotent.\npackage orset\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n)\n\n// Tag is a globally-unique add tag. Origin is the replica that minted it and\n// Seq is that replica's monotonic counter, so the pair (Origin, Seq) is unique\n// without any coordination. Counter minting is deterministic, which keeps the\n// whole simulation reproducible (no random UUIDs).\ntype Tag struct {\n\tOrigin string `json:\"origin\"`\n\tSeq    uint64 `json:\"seq\"`\n}\n\n// String renders a tag as \"origin:seq\".\nfunc (t Tag) String() string { return fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%d\", t.Origin, t.Seq) }\n\n// State is one replica's OR-Set state: the full add-tag map plus the set of\n// tombstoned tags. Adds maps element -> tags minted for it (every tag ever\n// observed, live or removed). Removed is a tombstone set.\n//\n// The zero value is a valid, empty set.\ntype State struct {\n\tAdds    map[string][]Tag `json:\"adds\"`\n\tRemoved map[Tag]struct{} `json:\"removed\"`\n}\n\n// New returns an empty OR-Set state.\nfunc New() *State {\n\treturn &State{\n\t\tAdds:    make(map[string][]Tag),\n\t\tRemoved: make(map[Tag]struct{}),\n\t}\n}\n\n// Clone returns a deep copy of s.\nfunc (s *State) Clone() *State {\n\tc := New()\n\tfor e, tags := range s.Adds {\n\t\tcp := make([]Tag, len(tags))\n\t\tcopy(cp, tags)\n\t\tc.Adds[e] = cp\n\t}\n\tfor t := range s.Removed {\n\t\tc.Removed[t] = struct{}{}\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\n// Add mints tag (origin, seq) and binds it to element. The caller guarantees\n// that seq is unique per origin (a monotonic counter on the origin replica).\n// Returns the minted tag so the simulator can record it in its trace.\nfunc (s *State) Add(origin string, seq uint64, element string) Tag {\n\tt := Tag{Origin: origin, Seq: seq}\n\ts.Adds[element] = append(s.Adds[element], t)\n\treturn t\n}\n\n// Remove tombstones, for element, exactly the tags currently visible on this\n// replica. Tags that have never been observed here — e.g. tags minted by a\n// concurrent add still in flight — are left untouched. This is the\n// \"observed-remove\" rule: removing what you cannot see cannot remove it.\n//\n// Returns the tombstoned tags (possibly empty: removing an absent element is a\n// no-op by design).\nfunc (s *State) Remove(element string) []Tag {\n\tvar removed []Tag\n\tfor _, t := range s.Adds[element] {\n\t\tif _, dead := s.Removed[t]; dead {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.Removed[t] = struct{}{}\n\t\tremoved = append(removed, t)\n\t}\n\treturn removed\n}\n\n// Lookup reports whether element is currently in the set: at least one of its\n// tags is live (present in Adds but absent from Removed).\nfunc (s *State) Lookup(element string) bool {\n\tfor _, t := range s.Adds[element] {\n\t\tif _, dead := s.Removed[t]; !dead {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Values returns the sorted list of elements currently in the set.\nfunc (s *State) Values() []string {\n\tvar out []string\n\tfor e := range s.Adds {\n\t\tif s.Lookup(e) {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, e)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tsort.Strings(out)\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Tombstones returns the set of observed-removed tags on this replica.\nfunc (s *State) Tombstones() map[Tag]struct{} { return s.Removed }\n\n// ContainsTag reports whether this state knows tag t at all.\nfunc (s *State) ContainsTag(t Tag) bool {\n\tfor _, tags := range s.Adds {\n\t\tfor _, x := range tags {\n\t\t\tif x == t {\n\t\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Merge unions other into the receiver (in place) and returns the receiver.\n//\n//\tAdds'    = Adds ∪ Adds_other      (union of add tags per element)\n//\tRemoved' = Removed ∪ Removed_other (union of tombstones)\n//\n// Both components are plain sets under union, therefore Merge is commutative,\n// associative and idempotent. The receiver becomes the join; other is never\n// mutated (Merge merges other *into* s).\nfunc (s *State) Merge(other *State) *State {\n\tif s.Adds == nil {\n\t\ts.Adds = make(map[string][]Tag)\n\t}\n\tif s.Removed == nil {\n\t\ts.Removed = make(map[Tag]struct{})\n\t}\n\tfor e, tags := range other.Adds {\n\t\thave := tagIndex(s.Adds[e])\n\t\tfor _, t := range tags {\n\t\t\tif !have[t] {\n\t\t\t\ts.Adds[e] = append(s.Adds[e], t)\n\t\t\t\thave[t] = true\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor t := range other.Removed {\n\t\ts.Removed[t] = struct{}{}\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\n// Equal reports structural equality (same tag map and same tombstone set),\n// independent of map/slice iteration order.\nfunc (s *State) Equal(o *State) bool {\n\tif len(s.Adds) != len(o.Adds) {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tif len(s.Removed) != len(o.Removed) {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tfor e, tags := range s.Adds {\n\t\totags, ok := o.Adds[e]\n\t\tif !ok || len(tags) != len(otags) {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t\ta := tagSet(tags)\n\t\tb := tagSet(otags)\n\t\tif len(a) != len(b) {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor t := range a {\n\t\t\tif _, ok := b[t]; !ok {\n\t\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor t := range s.Removed {\n\t\tif _, ok := o.Removed[t]; !ok {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// StableTags returns the tags of element that every replica named in replicas\n// has observed (i.e. the tag appears in every given state's Adds). Such tags\n// are safe to reclaim after every replica has also observed their tombstones.\n//\n// Reclamation stability precondition (see README \"墓碑回收\"): a tag and its\n// tombstone may only be discarded after a quorum-free all-replica barrier in\n// which every replica that could ever merge back has acknowledged knowing\n// both the tag and its removal. This helper tests the *observation* part of\n// that precondition; Reclaim performs the actual deletion only for tags that\n// are tombstoned here as well.\nfunc StableTags(element string, replicas ...*State) []Tag {\n\tif len(replicas) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tvar candidates map[Tag]bool\n\tfor _, r := range replicas {\n\t\tknown := tagIndex(r.Adds[element])\n\t\tif candidates == nil {\n\t\t\tcandidates = known\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor t := range candidates {\n\t\t\tif !known[t] {\n\t\t\t\tdelete(candidates, t)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tvar out []Tag\n\tfor t := range candidates {\n\t\tout = append(out, t)\n\t}\n\tsortTags(out)\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Reclaim discards, from this state, tags listed in tags if (and only if) the\n// tag is tombstoned in every replica named in witnesses. The witness check is\n// the stability barrier: the caller must pass the states of ALL replicas that\n// might ever be merged with this one afterwards (including replicas that are\n// currently partitioned, stopped, or could rejoin with an old snapshot).\n//\n// If that condition cannot be guaranteed the caller must not reclaim — a tag\n// reintroduced later by a straggler that never saw the tombstone would\n// resurrect the element. Reclaim returns the number of tags discarded.\nfunc (s *State) Reclaim(tags []Tag, witnesses ...*State) int {\n\tn := 0\n\tfor _, t := range tags {\n\t\tif _, deadHere := s.Removed[t]; !deadHere {\"time\":2, \"node\":\"n1\", \"op\":\"sync\"},\n      {\"time\":5, \"node\":\"n2\", \"op\":\"remove\", \"element\":\"a\"},\n      {\"time\":6, \"node\":\"n2\", \"op\":\"sync\"},\n      {\"time\":20, \"node\":\"n1\", \"op\":\"gc\"}\n    ],\n    \"max_ticks\": 0\n  }\n\nPOST /simulate accepts the same JSON body and returns the run report.\n`)\n\tos.Exit(2)\n}\n\nfunc runCmd(args []string) {\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"run\", flag.ExitOnError)\n\tout := fs.String(\"o\", \"\", \"write full report to file (default: stdout)\")\n\tshowTrace := fs.Bool(\"trace\", false, \"print the event trace := json.MarshalIndent(rep, \"\", \"  \")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tbody = append(body, '\\n')\n\tif *out != \"\" {\n\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(*out, body, 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Fatalf(\"write report: %v\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tfmt.Printf(\"report written to %s\\n\", *out)\n\t} else {\n\t\tos.Stdout.Write(body)\n\t}\n\tprintSummary(rep)\n\tif *showTrace {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, \"--- trace ---\")\n\t\tfor _, t := range rep.Trace {\n\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"t=%-4d %-7s %s\\n\", t.Time, t.Kind, traceLine(t))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc traceLine(t sim.Entry) string {\n\tswitch t.Kind {\n\tcase \"add\":\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s ADD %s tag=%s values=%v\", t.Node, t.Element, t.Tags, t.Values)\n\tcase \"remove\":\n\t\treturn t.Detail)\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn t.Detail\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc printSummary(r *sim.Report) {\n\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"converged=%v equal=%v final=%v ticks=%d counts=%v\\n\",\n\t\tr.Converged, Every ordering must (1) converge to\n// identical states, (2) keep the concurrent add, and (3) tolerate repeated\n// and out-of-order state deliveries.\nfunc TestAcceptance_ThreeReplicaEnumeration(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Local histories before any sync:\n\t//   R1: add x (tag R1:1), add a (R1:2), then remove x (tombstone R1:1)\n\t//   R2: add x (tag R2:1) — concurrent with R1's remove; add b\n\t//   R3: add c, stays an observer of late/duplicated syncs\n\tbuild := func() (r1, r2, r3 *State) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 = New(), New(), New()\n\t\tr1.Add(\"R1\", 1, \"x\")\n\t\tr1.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")\n\t\tr1.Remove(\"x\") // observed only R1:1\n\n\t\tr2.Add(\"R2\", 1, \"x\") // R2 never saw R1's add/remove\n\t\tr2.Add(\"R2\", 2, \"b\")\n\n\t\tr3.Add(\"R3\", 1, \"c\")\n\t\treturn r1, r2, r3\n\t}\n\twantValues := []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"x\"} // concurrent x (R2:1) survives\n\n\t// 1) Enumerate all 6 permutations of merging R1,R2,R3 into an empty sink.\n\tfor _, p := range permutations(3) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 := build()\n\t\tsrc := []*State{r1, r2, r3}\n\t\tsink := New()\n\t\tfor _, i := range p {\n\t\t\tsink.Merge(src[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tif got := sink.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"perm %v: values %v want %v\", p, got, wantValues)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 2) Enumerate pairwise gossip schedules: all 3! pair-orderings, and for\n\t// each, gossip in both directions, then verify every replica is identical.\n\tfor _, p := range permutations(3) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 := build()\n\t\tnodes := []*State{r1, r2, r3}\n\t\tpairs := [][2]int{{p[0], p[1]}, {p[0], p[2]}, {p[1], p[2]}}\n\t\tfor _, pr := range pairs {\n\t\t\ti, j := pr[0], pr[1]\n\t\t\tnodes[i].Merge(nodes[j])\n\t\t\tnodes[j].Merge(nodes[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i, n := range nodes {\n\t\t\tif !n.Equal(nodes[0]) {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"schedule %v: node %d diverged\", p, i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif got := n.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"schedule %v: values %v want %v\", p, got, wantValues)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 3) Out-of-order snapshots delivered to R3: an older snapshot that still\n\t// contains x live arrives AFTER a newer one carrying the tombstone — the\n\t// element must not resurrect; and the concurrent R2:1 must survive once\n\t// R2's snapshot shows up (in either order).\n\tr1, r2, _ := build()\n\tsnapNew := r1.Clone()                 // {a}, tombstone R1:1\n\tsnapOld := New()\n\tsnapOld.Add(\"R1\", 1, \"x\")\n\tsnapOld.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")             // {a,x}, no tombstone\n\tfor _, order := range [][]int{{0, 1}, {1, 0}} {\n\t\tr3 := New()\n\t\tsnaps := []*State{snapOld, snapNew}\n\t\tr3.Merge(snaps[order[0]])\n\t\tr3.Merge(snaps[order[1]])\n\t\tr3.Merge(r2) // concurrent add R2:1\n\t\tif got := r3.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ooo order %v: values %v want %v (x resurrection: %v)\",\n\t\t\t\torder, got, wantValues, r3.Lookup(\"x\") && hasOnly(r3, \"x\", \"R1\", 1))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 4) Repeated synchronisation: merging the same source 100 times is\n\t// identical to merging it once.\n\tr1, r2, r3 = build()\n\tonce := New().Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\trep := New()\n\tfor k := 0; k < 100; k++ {\n\t\trep.Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\t}\n\tif !rep.Equal(once) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"repeated sync did not converge to the same state as one sync\")\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rep.Values(), wantValues) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"repeated-sync values %v want %v\", rep.Values(), wantValues)\n\t}\n\n\t// 5) After everyone observes both x tags, a later remove clears x and\n\t// propagates by repeated sync — final join drops x, keeps a,b,c.\n\tjoin := New().Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\tjoin.Remove(\"x\")\n\tr1.Merge(join)\n\tfor k := 0; k < 3; k++ {\n\t\tr2.Merge(r1)\n\t\tr3.Merge(r1)\n\t}\n\tif r2.Lookup(\"x\") || r3.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"late observed-remove did not propagate through repeated sync\")\n\t}\n\tif got := join.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"post-remove values %v want [a b c]\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc hasOnly(s *State, elem, origin string, seq uint64) bool {\n\tfor _, t := range s.Adds[elem] {\n\t\tif _, dead := s.Removed[t]; !dead && (t.Origin != origin || t.Seq != seq) {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc permutations(n int) [][]int {\n\tvar out [][]int\n\ta := make([]int, n)\n\tfor i := range a {\n\t\ta[i] = i\n\t}\n\tvar rec func(int)\n\trec = func(k int) {\n\t\tif k == 1 {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, append([]int(nil), a...))\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i := 0; i < k; i++ {\n\t\t\trec(k - 1)\n\t\t\tif k%2 == 0 {\n\t\t\t\ta[i], a[k-1] = a[k-1], a[i]\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\ta[0], a[k-1] = a[k-1], a[0]\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\trec(n)\n\tif len(out) != 6 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"permutations: got %d\", len(out)))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_127742ea83548f17596e0eb3","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":435,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":76600,"output_tokens":2066,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_j705lef56hrajxuwja3x08l0":{"content":"package orset\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// TestAcceptance_ThreeReplicaEnumeration is the headline acceptance check:\n// three replicas add elements, one removes an observed element while another\n// add of the same element is concurrent, and every possible ordering of\n// merging the three states is enumerated. Every ordering must (1) converge to\n// identical states, (2) keep the concurrent add, and (3) tolerate repeated\n// and out-of-order state deliveries.\nfunc TestAcceptance_ThreeReplicaEnumeration(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Local histories before any sync:\n\t//   R1: add x (tag R1:1), add a (R1:2), then remove x (tombstone R1:1)\n\t//   R2: add x (tag R2:1) — concurrent with R1's remove; add b\n\t//   R3: add c, stays an observer of late/duplicated syncs\n\tbuild := func() (r1, r2, r3 *State) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 = New(), New(), New()\n\t\tr1.Add(\"R1\", 1, \"x\")\n\t\tr1.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")\n\t\tr1.Remove(\"x\") // observed only R1:1\n\n\t\tr2.Add(\"R2\", 1, \"x\") // R2 never saw R1's add/remove\n\t\tr2.Add(\"R2\", 2, \"b\")\n\n\t\tr3.Add(\"R3\", 1, \"c\")\n\t\treturn r1, r2, r3\n\t}\n\twantValues := []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"x\"} // concurrent x (R2:1) survives\n\n\t// 1) Enumerate all 6 permutations of merging R1,R2,R3 into an empty sink.\n\tfor _, p := range permutations(3) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 := build()\n\t\tsrc := []*State{r1, r2, r3}\n\t\tsink := New()\n\t\tfor _, i := range p {\n\t\t\tsink.Merge(src[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tif got := sink.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"perm %v: values %v want %v\", p, got, wantValues)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 2) Enumerate pairwise gossip schedules: all 3! pair-orderings, and for\n\t// each, gossip in both directions, then verify every replica is identical.\n\tfor _, p := range permutations(3) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 := build()\n\t\tnodes := []*State{r1, r2, r3}\n\t\tpairs := [][2]int{{p[0], p[1]}, {p[0], p[2]}, {p[1], p[2]}}\n\t\tfor _, pr := range pairs {\n\t\t\ti, j := pr[0], pr[1]\n\t\t\tnodes[i].Merge(nodes[j])\n\t\t\tnodes[j].Merge(nodes[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i, n := range nodes {\n\t\t\tif !n.Equal(nodes[0]) {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"schedule %v: node %d diverged\", p, i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif got := n.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"schedule %v: values %v want %v\", p, got, wantValues)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 3) Out-of-order snapshots delivered to R3: an older snapshot that still\n\t// contains x live arrives AFTER a newer one carrying the tombstone — the\n\t// element must not resurrect; and the concurrent R2:1 must survive once\n\t// R2's snapshot shows up (in either order).\n\tr1, r2, _ := build()\n\tsnapNew := r1.Clone()                 // {a}, tombstone R1:1\n\tsnapOld := New()\n\tsnapOld.Add(\"R1\", 1, \"x\")\n\tsnapOld.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")             // {a,x}, no tombstone\n\tfor _, order := range [][]int{{0, 1}, {1, 0}} {\n\t\tr3 := New()\n\t\tsnaps := []*State{snapOld, snapNew}\n\t\tr3.Merge(snaps[order[0]])\n\t\tr3.Merge(snaps[order[1]])\n\t\tr3.Merge(r2) // concurrent add R2:1\n\t\tif got := r3.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ooo order %v: values %v want %v (x resurrection: %v)\",\n\t\t\t\torder, got, wantValues, r3.Lookup(\"x\") && hasOnly(r3, \"x\", \"R1\", 1))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 4) Repeated synchronisation: merging the same source 100 times is\n\t// identical to merging it once.\n\tr1, r2, r3 = build()\n\tonce := New().Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\trep := New()\n\tfor k := 0; k < 100; k++ {\n\t\trep.Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\t}\n\tif !rep.Equal(once) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"repeated sync did not converge to the same state as one sync\")\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rep.Values(), wantValues) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"repeated-sync values %v want %v\", rep.Values(), wantValues)\n\t}\n\n\t// 5) After everyone observes both x tags, a later remove clears x and\n\t// propagates by repeated sync — final join drops x, keeps a,b,c.\n\tjoin := New().Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\tjoin.Remove(\"x\")\n\tr1.Merge(join)\n\tfor k := 0; k < 3; k++ {\n\t\tr2.Merge(r1)\n\t\tr3.Merge(r1)\n\t}\n\tif r2.Lookup(\"x\") || r3.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"late observed-remove did not propagate through repeated sync\")\n\t}\n\tif got := join.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"post-remove values %v want [a b c]\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc hasOnly(s *State, elem, origin string, seq uint64) bool {\n\tfor _, t := range s.Adds[elem] {\n\t\tif _, dead := s.Removed[t]; !dead && (t.Origin != origin || t.Seq != seq) {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc permutations(n int) [][]int {\n\tvar out [][]int\n\ta := make([]int, n)\n\tfor i := range a {\n\t\ta[i] = i\n\t}\n\tvar rec func(int)\n\trec = func(k int) {\n\t\tif k == 1 {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, append([]int(nil), a...))\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i := 0; i < k; i++ {\n\t\t\trec(k - 1)\n\t\t\tif k%2 == 0 {\n\t\t\t\ta[i], a[k-1] = a[k-1], a[i]\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\ta[0], a[k-1] = a[k-1], a[0]\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\trec(n)\n\tif len(out) != 6 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"permutations: got %d\", len(out)))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":69,"oldLines":7,"newStart":69,"newLines":7,"lines":["   // contains x live arrives AFTER a newer one carrying the tombstone — the","   // element must not resurrect; Every ordering must (1) converge to\n// identical states, (2) keep the concurrent add, and (3) tolerate repeated\n// and out-of-order state deliveries.\nfunc TestAcceptance_ThreeReplicaEnumeration(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Local histories before any sync:\n\t//   R1: add x (tag R1:1), add a (R1:2), then remove x (tombstone R1:1)\n\t//   R2: add x (tag R2:1) — concurrent with R1's remove; add b\n\t//   R3: add c, stays an observer of late/duplicated syncs\n\tbuild := func() (r1, r2, r3 *State) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 = New(), New(), New()\n\t\tr1.Add(\"R1\", 1, \"x\")\n\t\tr1.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")\n\t\tr1.Remove(\"x\") // observed only R1:1\n\n\t\tr2.Add(\"R2\", 1, \"x\") // R2 never saw R1's add/remove\n\t\tr2.Add(\"R2\", 2, \"b\")\n\n\t\tr3.Add(\"R3\", 1, \"c\")\n\t\treturn r1, r2, r3\n\t}\n\twantValues := []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"x\"} // concurrent x (R2:1) survives\n\n\t// 1) Enumerate all 6 permutations of merging R1,R2,R3 into an empty sink.\n\tfor _, p := range permutations(3) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 := build()\n\t\tsrc := []*State{r1, r2, r3}\n\t\tsink := New()\n\t\tfor _, i := range p {\n\t\t\tsink.Merge(src[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tif got := sink.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"perm %v: values %v want %v\", p, got, wantValues)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 2) Enumerate pairwise gossip schedules: all 3! pair-orderings, and for\n\t// each, gossip in both directions, then verify every replica is identical.\n\tfor _, p := range permutations(3) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 := build()\n\t\tnodes := []*State{r1, r2, r3}\n\t\tpairs := [][2]int{{p[0], p[1]}, {p[0], p[2]}, {p[1], p[2]}}\n\t\tfor _, pr := range pairs {\n\t\t\ti, j := pr[0], pr[1]\n\t\t\tnodes[i].Merge(nodes[j])\n\t\t\tnodes[j].Merge(nodes[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i, n := range nodes {\n\t\t\tif !n.Equal(nodes[0]) {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"schedule %v: node %d diverged\", p, i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif got := n.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"schedule %v: values %v want %v\", p, got, wantValues)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 3) Out-of-order snapshots delivered to R3: an older snapshot that still\n\t// contains x live arrives AFTER a newer one carrying the tombstone — the\n\t// element must not resurrect; and the concurrent R2:1 must survive once\n\t// R2's snapshot shows up (in either order).\n\tr1, r2, _ = build()\n\tsnapNew := r1.Clone()                 // {a}, tombstone R1:1\n\tsnapOld := New()\n\tsnapOld.Add(\"R1\", 1, \"x\")\n\tsnapOld.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")             // {a,x}, no tombstone\n\tfor _, order := range [][]int{{0, 1}, {1, 0}} {\n\t\tr3 := New()\n\t\tsnaps := []*State{snapOld, snapNew}\n\t\tr3.Merge(snaps[order[0]])\n\t\tr3.Merge(snaps[order[1]])\n\t\tr3.Merge(r2) // concurrent add R2:1\n\t\tif got := r3.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ooo order %v: values %v want %v (x resurrection: %v)\",\n\t\t\t\torder, got, wantValues, r3.Lookup(\"x\") && hasOnly(r3, \"x\", \"R1\", 1))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 4) Repeated synchronisation: merging the same source 100 times is\n\t// identical to merging it once.\n\tr1, r2, r3 = build()\n\tonce := New().Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\trep := New()\n\tfor k := 0; k < 100; k++ {\n\t\trep.Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\t}\n\tif !rep.Equal(once) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"repeated sync did not converge to the same state as one sync\")\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rep.Values(), wantValues) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"repeated-sync values %v want %v\", rep.Values(), wantValues)\n\t}\n\n\t// 5) After everyone observes both x tags, a later remove clears x and\n\t// propagates by repeated sync — final join drops x, keeps a,b,c.\n\tjoin := New().Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\tjoin.Remove(\"x\")\n\tr1.Merge(join)\n\tfor k := 0; k < 3; k++ {\n\t\tr2.Merge(r1)\n\t\tr3.Merge(r1)\n\t}\n\tif r2.Lookup(\"x\") || r3.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"late observed-remove did not propagate through repeated sync\")\n\t}\n\tif got := join.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"post-remove values %v want [a b c]\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc hasOnly(s *State, elem, origin string, seq uint64) bool {\n\tfor _, t := range s.Adds[elem] {\n\t\tif _, dead := s.Removed[t]; !dead && (t.Origin != origin || t.Seq != seq) {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc permutations(n int) [][]int {\n\tvar out [][]int\n\ta := make([]int, n)\n\tfor i := range a {\n\t\ta[i] = i\n\t}\n\tvar rec func(int)\n\trec = func(k int) {\n\t\tif k == 1 {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, append([]int(nil), a...))\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i := 0; i < k; i++ {\n\t\t\trec(k - 1)\n\t\t\tif k%2 == 0 {\n\t\t\t\ta[i], a[k-1] = a[k-1], a[i]\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\ta[0], a[k-1] = a[k-1], a[0]\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\trec(n)\n\tif len(out) != 6 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"permutations: got %d\", len(out)))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":30,"oldLines":10,"newStart":30,"newLines":11,"lines":["     return r1, r2, r3","   }","   wantValues := []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"x\"} // concurrent x (R2:1) survives","+  var r1, r2, r3 *State"," ","   // 1) Enumerate all 6 permutations of merging R1,R2,R3 into an empty sink.","   for _, p := range permutations(3) {","-    r1, r2, r3 := build()","+    r1, r2, r3 = build()","     src := []*State{r1, r2, r3}","     sink := New()","     for _, i := range p {"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"fa6cc81c-bfb9-4d50-bd32-3d27eb90bf8a","session_id":"1075e89c-721a-4815-a8c4-855fcf29d7cd","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp23/a","sessionId":"1075e89c-721a-4815-a8c4-855fcf29d7cd","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp23-a","slug":"joyful-discovering-spark"}

Every ordering must (1) converge to\n// identical states, (2) keep the concurrent add, and (3) tolerate repeated\n// and out-of-order state deliveries.\nfunc TestAcceptance_ThreeReplicaEnumeration(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Local histories before any sync:\n\t//   R1: add x (tag R1:1), add a (R1:2), then remove x (tombstone R1:1)\n\t//   R2: add x (tag R2:1) — concurrent with R1's remove; add b\n\t//   R3: add c, stays an observer of late/duplicated syncs\n\tbuild := func() (r1, r2, r3 *State) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 = New(), New(), New()\n\t\tr1.Add(\"R1\", 1, \"x\")\n\t\tr1.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")\n\t\tr1.Remove(\"x\") // observed only R1:1\n\n\t\tr2.Add(\"R2\", 1, \"x\") // R2 never saw R1's add/remove\n\t\tr2.Add(\"R2\", 2, \"b\")\n\n\t\tr3.Add(\"R3\", 1, \"c\")\n\t\treturn r1, r2, r3\n\t}\n\twantValues := []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"x\"} // concurrent x (R2:1) survives\n\tvar r1, r2, r3 *State\n\n\t// 1) Enumerate all 6 permutations of merging R1,R2,R3 into an empty sink.\n\tfor _, p := range permutations(3) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 = build()\n\t\tsrc := []*State{r1, r2, r3}\n\t\tsink := New()\n\t\tfor _, i := range p {\n\t\t\tsink.Merge(src[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tif got := sink.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"perm %v: values %v want %v\", p, got, wantValues)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 2) Enumerate pairwise gossip schedules: all 3! pair-orderings, and for\n\t// each, gossip in both directions, then verify every replica is identical.\n\tfor _, p := range permutations(3) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 := build()\n\t\tnodes := []*State{r1, r2, r3}\n\t\tpairs := [][2]int{{p[0], p[1]}, {p[0], p[2]}, {p[1], p[2]}}\n\t\tfor _, pr := range pairs {\n\t\t\ti, j := pr[0], pr[1]\n\t\t\tnodes[i].Merge(nodes[j])\n\t\t\tnodes[j].Merge(nodes[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i, n := range nodes {\n\t\t\tif !n.Equal(nodes[0]) {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"schedule %v: node %d diverged\", p, i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif got := n.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"schedule %v: values %v want %v\", p, got, wantValues)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 3) Out-of-order snapshots delivered to R3: an older snapshot that still\n\t// contains x live arrives AFTER a newer one carrying the tombstone — the\n\t// element must not resurrect; and the concurrent R2:1 must survive once\n\t// R2's snapshot shows up (in either order).\n\tr1, r2, _ = build()\n\tsnapNew := r1.Clone()                 // {a}, tombstone R1:1\n\tsnapOld := New()\n\tsnapOld.Add(\"R1\", 1, \"x\")\n\tsnapOld.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")             // {a,x}, no tombstone\n\tfor _, order := range [][]int{{0, 1}, {1, 0}} {\n\t\tr3 := New()\n\t\tsnaps := []*State{snapOld, snapNew}\n\t\tr3.Merge(snaps[order[0]])\n\t\tr3.Merge(snaps[order[1]])\n\t\tr3.Merge(r2) // concurrent add R2:1\n\t\tif got := r3.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ooo order %v: values %v want %v (x resurrection: %v)\",\n\t\t\t\torder, got, wantValues, r3.Lookup(\"x\") && hasOnly(r3, \"x\", \"R1\", 1))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 4) Repeated synchronisation: merging the same source 100 times is\n\t// identical to merging it once.\n\tr1, r2, r3 = build()\n\tonce := New().Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\trep := New()\n\tfor k := 0; k < 100; k++ {\n\t\trep.Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\t}\n\tif !rep.Equal(once) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"repeated sync did not converge to the same state as one sync\")\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rep.Values(), wantValues) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"repeated-sync values %v want %v\", rep.Values(), wantValues)\n\t}\n\n\t// 5) After everyone observes both x tags, a later remove clears x and\n\t// propagates by repeated sync — final join drops x, keeps a,b,c.\n\tjoin := New().Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\tjoin.Remove(\"x\")\n\tr1.Merge(join)\n\tfor k := 0; k < 3; k++ {\n\t\tr2.Merge(r1)\n\t\tr3.Merge(r1)\n\t}\n\tif r2.Lookup(\"x\") || r3.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"late observed-remove did not propagate through repeated sync\")\n\t}\n\tif got := join.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"post-remove values %v want [a b c]\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc hasOnly(s *State, elem, origin string, seq uint64) bool {\n\tfor _, t := range s.Adds[elem] {\n\t\tif _, dead := s.Removed[t]; !dead && (t.Origin != origin || t.Seq != seq) {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc permutations(n int) [][]int {\n\tvar out [][]int\n\ta := make([]int, n)\n\tfor i := range a {\n\t\ta[i] = i\n\t}\n\tvar rec func(int)\n\trec = func(k int) {\n\t\tif k == 1 {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, append([]int(nil), a...))\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i := 0; i < k; i++ {\n\t\t\trec(k - 1)\n\t\t\tif k%2 == 0 {\n\t\t\t\ta[i], a[k-1] = a[k-1], a[i]\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\ta[0], a[k-1] = a[k-1], a[0]\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\trec(n)\n\tif len(out) != 6 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"permutations: got %d\", len(out)))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":48,"oldLines":7,"newStart":48,"newLines":7,"lines":["   // 2) Enumerate pairwise gossip schedules: all 3! pair-orderings, and for","   // each, gossip in both directions, then verify every replica is identical.","   for _, p := range permutations(3) {","-    r1, r2, r3 := build()","+    r1, r2, r3 = build()","     nodes := []*State{r1, r2, r3}","     pairs := [][2]int{{p[0], p[1]}, {p[0], p[2]}, {p[1], p[2]}}","     for _, pr := range pairs {"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"5af41fad-fd15-4035-b759-f5ec8a625fdb","session_id":"1075e89c-721a-4815-a8c4-855fcf29d7cd","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp23/a","sessionId":"1075e89c-721a-4815-a8c4-855fcf29d7cd","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp23-a","slug":"joyful-discovering-spark"}

Every ordering must (1) converge to\n// identical states, (2) keep the concurrent add, and (3) tolerate repeated\n// and out-of-order state deliveries.\nfunc TestAcceptance_ThreeReplicaEnumeration(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Local histories before any sync:\n\t//   R1: add x (tag R1:1), add a (R1:2), then remove x (tombstone R1:1)\n\t//   R2: add x (tag R2:1) — concurrent with R1's remove; add b\n\t//   R3: add c, stays an observer of late/duplicated syncs\n\tbuild := func() (r1, r2, r3 *State) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 = New(), New(), New()\n\t\tr1.Add(\"R1\", 1, \"x\")\n\t\tr1.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")\n\t\tr1.Remove(\"x\") // observed only R1:1\n\n\t\tr2.Add(\"R2\", 1, \"x\") // R2 never saw R1's add/remove\n\t\tr2.Add(\"R2\", 2, \"b\")\n\n\t\tr3.Add(\"R3\", 1, \"c\")\n\t\treturn r1, r2, r3\n\t}\n\twantValues := []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\", \"x\"} // concurrent x (R2:1) survives\n\tvar r1, r2, r3 *State\n\n\t// 1) Enumerate all 6 permutations of merging R1,R2,R3 into an empty sink.\n\tfor _, p := range permutations(3) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 = build()\n\t\tsrc := []*State{r1, r2, r3}\n\t\tsink := New()\n\t\tfor _, i := range p {\n\t\t\tsink.Merge(src[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tif got := sink.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"perm %v: values %v want %v\", p, got, wantValues)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 2) Enumerate pairwise gossip schedules: all 3! pair-orderings, and for\n\t// each, gossip in both directions, then verify every replica is identical.\n\tfor _, p := range permutations(3) {\n\t\tr1, r2, r3 = build()\n\t\tnodes := []*State{r1, r2, r3}\n\t\tpairs := [][2]int{{p[0], p[1]}, {p[0], p[2]}, {p[1], p[2]}}\n\t\tfor _, pr := range pairs {\n\t\t\ti, j := pr[0], pr[1]\n\t\t\tnodes[i].Merge(nodes[j])\n\t\t\tnodes[j].Merge(nodes[i])\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i, n := range nodes {\n\t\t\tif !n.Equal(nodes[0]) {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"schedule %v: node %d diverged\", p, i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif got := n.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"schedule %v: values %v want %v\", p, got, wantValues)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 3) Out-of-order snapshots delivered to R3: an older snapshot that still\n\t// contains x live arrives AFTER a newer one carrying the tombstone — the\n\t// element must not resurrect; and the concurrent R2:1 must survive once\n\t// R2's snapshot shows up (in either order).\n\tr1, r2, _ = build()\n\tsnapNew := r1.Clone()                 // {a}, tombstone R1:1\n\tsnapOld := New()\n\tsnapOld.Add(\"R1\", 1, \"x\")\n\tsnapOld.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")             // {a,x}, no tombstone\n\tfor _, order := range [][]int{{0, 1}, {1, 0}} {\n\t\tr3 := New()\n\t\tsnaps := []*State{snapOld, snapNew}\n\t\tr3.Merge(snaps[order[0]])\n\t\tr3.Merge(snaps[order[1]])\n\t\tr3.Merge(r2) // concurrent add R2:1\n\t\tif got := r3.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, wantValues) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ooo order %v: values %v want %v (x resurrection: %v)\",\n\t\t\t\torder, got, wantValues, r3.Lookup(\"x\") && hasOnly(r3, \"x\", \"R1\", 1))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 4) Repeated synchronisation: merging the same source 100 times is\n\t// identical to merging it once.\n\tr1, r2, r3 = build()\n\tonce := New().Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\trep := New()\n\tfor k := 0; k < 100; k++ {\n\t\trep.Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\t}\n\tif !rep.Equal(once) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"repeated sync did not converge to the same state as one sync\")\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rep.Values(), wantValues) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"repeated-sync values %v want %v\", rep.Values(), wantValues)\n\t}\n\n\t// 5) After everyone observes both x tags, a later remove clears x and\n\t// propagates by repeated sync — final join drops x, keeps a,b,c.\n\tjoin := New().Merge(r1).Merge(r2).Merge(r3)\n\tjoin.Remove(\"x\")\n\tr1.Merge(join)\n\tfor k := 0; k < 3; k++ {\n\t\tr2.Merge(r1)\n\t\tr3.Merge(r1)\n\t}\n\tif r2.Lookup(\"x\") || r3.Lookup(\"x\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"late observed-remove did not propagate through repeated sync\")\n\t}\n\tif got := join.Values(); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{\"a\", \"b\", \"c\"}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"post-remove values %v want [a b c]\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc hasOnly(s *State, elem, origin string, seq uint64) bool {\n\tfor _, t := range s.Adds[elem] {\n\t\tif _, dead := s.Removed[t]; !dead && (t.Origin != origin || t.Seq != seq) {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc permutations(n int) [][]int {\n\tvar out [][]int\n\ta := make([]int, n)\n\tfor i := range a {\n\t\ta[i] = i\n\t}\n\tvar rec func(int)\n\trec = func(k int) {\n\t\tif k == 1 {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, append([]int(nil), a...))\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i := 0; i < k; i++ {\n\t\t\trec(k - 1)\n\t\t\tif k%2 == 0 {\n\t\t\t\ta[i], a[k-1] = a[k-1], a[i]\n\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\ta[0], a[k-1] = a[k-1], a[0]\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\trec(n)\n\tif len(out) != 6 {\n\t\tpanic(fmt.Sprintf(\"permutations: got %d\", len(out)))\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":77,"oldLines":6,"newStart":77,"newLines":7,"lines":["   snapOld.Add(\"R1\", 2, \"a\")             // {a,x}, no tombstone","   for _, order := range [][]int{{0, 1}, {1, 0}} {","     r3 := New()","+    r3.Add(\"R3\", 1, \"c\") // receiver's local add","     snaps := []*State{snapOld, snapNew}","     r3.Merge(snaps[order[0]])","     r3.Merge(snaps[order[1]])"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d2aed86c-365e-4b7b-adfe-4c068ced12d1","session_id":"1075e89c-721a-4815-a8c4-855fcf29d7cd","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp23/a","sessionId":"1075e89c-721a-4815-a8c4-855fcf29d7cd","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp23-a","slug":"joyful-discovering-spark"}
